name: Firecrawl
tagline: LLM-ready web scraping and crawling API for clean, structured page data
description: Firecrawl turns websites into clean, LLM-ready markdown, HTML, and structured JSON via scrape, crawl, map, and extract endpoints. Developers send a URL (or site) and receive token-friendly content with optional AI extraction schemas, suitable for RAG pipelines, agents, and data workflows. Authentication uses a Bearer API key from a self-serve dashboard.

auth.details: Bearer API key in Authorization header (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY); obtain key from Firecrawl dashboard after self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan includes a limited credit allotment for new accounts (commonly cited as ~500 credits); exact free quota and whether it renews vary—confirm on firecrawl.dev/pricing. Credits scale by endpoint (scrape vs crawl vs extract).
pricing.paid_plans: Hobby, Standard, Growth, and Enterprise tiers billed by credits/month with higher concurrency and features; see firecrawl.dev/pricing for current prices.

rate_limits: Plan-based concurrency and request limits (not a single public global RPS number); higher tiers raise concurrent browsers/requests. Check dashboard or pricing for your plan; not fully published as one fixed limit.

example.request:
curl -X POST https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/scrape \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -d '{"url":"https://example.com","formats":["markdown"]}'
example.response_snippet: {"success":true,"data":{"markdown":"# Example Domain\n\nThis domain is for use in illustrative examples...","metadata":{"title":"Example Domain","sourceURL":"https://example.com","statusCode":200}}}

use_cases: scrape a URL to clean markdown for RAG or LLM context
crawl a documentation site and return multi-page content
map all discovered URLs on a domain before selective scraping
extract structured fields from a page with a JSON schema
batch-scrape a list of product or article URLs
